messages:
Evan Strauss: Quick check-in 1: partner asked for a single manifest we can reuse across AWS/GCP/Azure but with per-cloud overrides. Is that feasible?
Meera Shah: Yes, we can do a base manifest + override sections. We'll need to define which fields are overrideable (sku, pricing, region_restrictions, thumbnails).
Luca Bianchi: A couple notes: (1) Azure requires both small & large icons, (2) AWS wants an `OwnerAccountId` in AMI metadata, (3) GCP needs the service account for provisioning.
Evan Strauss: Good. Can we standardize naming for SKUs so partners don't get confused by region variants? Suggest pattern: rwd.<offer>.<cloud>.<tier> e.g., rwd.core.aws.standard
Meera Shah: That works. I'll draft a SKU naming guideline and include a migration map for legacy SKUs.
compliance-bot: Reminder: any cross-border data handling must include `data_location` metadata and DPA attached.
Luca Bianchi: For pricing, partners want examples in the manifest. I'll add three sample pricing rows: SaaS-per-token, SaaS-subscription, AMI-instance-hour. We'll also add `marketplace_fee_pct`.
Evan Strauss: Who's taking responsibility for the final legal copy inclusion? Meera?
Meera Shah: Yep I'll coordinate with Legal and paste the approved EULA + DPA links into the manifest. ETA 48 hrs.
catalog-bot: Asset check: missing large icon for azure and 1200x900 hero for gcp.
Evan Strauss: I'll upload placeholders tonight. Meera, once you have legal copy I'll swap the placeholders.
Luca Bianchi: One more operational item: add a `maintainer_contact` and `last_scanned` field into manifest for AMIs. Partners asked about patch cadence.
Meera Shah: Agreed. Also adding `provisioning_flow` values: redirect, api_provision, marketplace_provision. This helps ops triage.
Evan Strauss: Plan: Meera drafts manifest template, Luca adds pricing examples, I'll handle asset uploads. Lock manifest by Friday and run partner review next week.
Meera Shah: Draft will be in the shared doc. I'll add a short example snippet and the SKU migration table.
Luca Bianchi: Added an example AMI metadata snippet and a note about automated Inspec scans.
Evan Strauss: Thanks all 1: once the manifest is stable we'll open the marketplace PR and attach Jira tickets for traceability.
